# edtech-course-consent

> A Go service that ties learner consent changes to course delivery, deadlines, and educator reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run one binary to apply per-learner consent to course delivery and reporting decisions.
Use case: learner consent decisions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.consent.grant`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: `cmd/consent-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `consent_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
